admission.shape: `style <targets> <key>:<value>[, ...]` with the closed property set, flat `text` children and `text id["Label"]`
admission.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 measured live
admission.twin_rule: the twin removes the style statements and strips text ids; the outline above the footer must be cell-equal

selection.rule: venn fallbacks whose only remaining blocker is the closed style statement (plus flat text children / text ids)

review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial code review (fresh general-purpose agent, D-453 venn style admission, 2026-11-23)
review.note: Reviewer re-ran the generator --check entry and the live gate and verified: only the four closed style properties are admitted with validated values; duplicate statements and duplicate properties fail closed; flat text children and text ids are inert; classDef/::: stay whole-source; the disclosure footer appends after the outline and style-free twins are cell-exact.
